# Paramount Paint Company LLC

> Owner-run painting company in Rexburg, Idaho, founded in 2018 by Dylan Webster. Interior house painting, kitchen cabinets, trim, doors and railings, drywall patching, and commercial interiors painted at night or on weekends. Serves Rexburg, Idaho Falls, Ammon, Sugar City, Island Park and Roberts. Rated 5.0 on Google (19 reviews).
